subject: New time?
text: Hi, the call tomorrow is hard. I am the customer contact. Can we meet later? Thursday afternoon is free. I can also meet Friday morning. Please check your schedule. Send a new invite if one works. I need time to prepare notes. The topic will not change. I will bring the report from last time. You can keep the same link. Reply when possible. No rush, but please confirm soon. Thanks for understanding. I appreciate the flexibility. I can join from home. I can talk clearly. Bring any questions. That is all.
